instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Say how much a row is used as of a moment, its use heat halving with time, and the heat record one more use leaves", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:heat-of-a-row and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Give kept (the row's heat record { heat, at }, or nothing for a row never used), now (an ISO time; the current time otherwise) and used: true to also get the record a use leaves now (null when the row was used within the last 360 minutes, so nothing is written).
